summary.headline: The Board of Health approved a septic variance for 66 Breakneck Hill Road to support a commercial-to-residential conversion.
summary.summary: The Southborough Board of Health granted a septic setback variance for 66 Breakneck Hill Road to accommodate a four-bedroom single-family conversion with advanced nitrogen treatment. Staff reported that seasonal flu clinics are wrapping up across schools, daycares, and emergency services. Due to an agenda posting oversight, the board deferred its annual budget review to a special meeting scheduled for October 20.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The board approved minutes from its September 15, 2026 meeting and later adjourned.
key_details: Minutes from September 15, 2026 were approved as written.

topics.title: Town flu clinic updates
topics.summary: Staff provided an update on town-run influenza vaccination clinics. Supplies are nearly exhausted following three weeks of clinics across town.
key_details: Clinics have been running for three weeks and vaccine supply is nearly depleted.
Remaining clinics are planned for two schools and two daycares.
Vaccinations for police and fire department personnel across shifts are underway over the coming days.
Early seasonal Influenza A cases have already been detected in the community.

topics.title: Septic variance for 66 Breakneck Hill Road
topics.summary: Engineer Evan Carloni presented a septic variance request for 66 Breakneck Hill Road to support converting the property from commercial use to a single-family home. The proposed system improves upon existing conditions near a wetland tributary to the Sudbury Reservoir.
key_details: The conversion from commercial use to a four-bedroom residential home increases design flow from 330 gallons per day to 440 gallons per day.
The applicant requested an 85-foot setback from wetlands where local regulations require 100 feet near drinking water tributaries.
The proposed leaching field is 6 feet farther from the wetland than the existing 1999 system, which had a 79-foot setback waiver.
The plan incorporates a Singulair 960 DN nitrogen-reducing treatment tank and provides 5 feet of separation to the groundwater table instead of the required 4 feet.
The property owner explained the extra bedroom is needed to accommodate family visits following the birth of a child.
topics.outcome: Variance approved unanimously, contingent on Conservation Commission approval and health agent sign-off.

topics.title: Budget review delay and future meeting scheduling
topics.summary: The board's operating budget was delayed because it was not posted to the public agenda in time under open meeting law. The board scheduled an upcoming special meeting to vote on the budget and finalized its late-autumn calendar.
key_details: The budget could not be taken up because it was omitted from the timely posted agenda.
A special meeting was scheduled for October 20 at 10:00 AM to review and approve the budget.
The November 17 regular meeting time was adjusted from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM.
The December regular meeting was scheduled for December 15 at 9:30 AM.
topics.outcome: Special budget meeting scheduled for October 20, 2026.

votes.motion: Approve the septic variance for 66 Breakneck Hill Road contingent upon Conservation Commission approval and authorize the health agent to sign off on behalf of the board.

upcoming.what: Special Board of Health meeting to review and approve the budget
